subject.title: Prompt-cache prefix churn on OpenAI models: per-turn dynamic injections (message tool hint + volatile system-prompt section) defeat automatic prefix caching

question: Should `message_tool_only` visible-reply guidance stay in the `message` tool schema, move to late turn/user context for OpenAI-style prefix caching, or split by provider cache behavior?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally use schema-level steering for delivery correctness, but the issue's measured cache misses and current OpenAI tool serialization show that placement is still cache-sensitive.

options.title: Move hint below OpenAI cached prefix
options.body: Keep tool descriptions stable and carry the visible-reply directive in late turn context for OpenAI-style providers, with tests for delivery behavior and prefix byte stability.

options.title: Keep schema-level hint
options.body: Accept the cache churn as a delivery-steering tradeoff and document the OpenAI prompt-cache limitation.

options.title: Provider-specific split
options.body: Keep schema-level hints where explicit cache-control boundaries make that safe, but use late-turn hints for OpenAI automatic-prefix providers.

recommendation.title: Move hint below OpenAI cached prefix
recommendation.body: Keep tool descriptions stable and carry the visible-reply directive in late turn context for OpenAI-style providers, with tests for delivery behavior and prefix byte stability.
